column1: # repeat_compare manifest — tab-separated, "#"-prefixed lines and blank lines ignored.
# Columns: species_id  species_name  fasta  tissue  accession  [satellite_lib]
#   species_id  short code, [A-Za-z0-9]+, unique. Used as a wildcard and in
#               paths; also the library-name prefix unless
#               satellite.harmonization_dir is set (then the stage-02b code,
#               e.g. EST, is used as the prefix instead).
#   species_name  "Genus species". With satellite.harmonization_dir set it must
#               match the binomial stage 02b was given (case/whitespace-insensitive).
#   fasta       absolute path to the assembly FASTA (may be gzipped).
#   tissue      germline | soma | unknown.
#   accession   optional; metadata only, never downloaded.
#   satellite_lib optional 6th column (may be omitted entirely): satellite motif
#               FASTA (#Class/Family headers) to screen this species with. Usually
#               left empty and supplied for every species via
#               satellite.harmonization_dir; a value here is a per-species
#               override that only goes into this species' own-arm library.
# This file is an EXAMPLE with placeholders — replace with real absolute
# paths and confirmed tissue values before running for real.
